scope: Synthetic fixtures under /tmp only; fixed real CLI roots not accessed; no real preflight or apply
limitations: No exclusive lock against concurrent directory renames or edits; existing-file compare/replace is not atomic CAS. Stop concurrent editing for delivery; failure requires inspection, no automatic retry.

Both manifest publications and exit 0 are needed. A later publication failure can leave the staging manifest and partially delivered target; staging manifest alone is not success. No directory-entry crash/power-loss guarantee.
Existing ordinary permission bits are preserved, but previous hash-only manifest cannot verify ACL, ownership or extended-attribute changes.
